win: DDI System Inform - Sample Co › Projected Purchase Order
name: Projected Purchase Order
Advanced Demand Forecasting and Purchasing
val:
Inform ERP introduces sophisticated demand management, real-time reorder quantity calculation, and a redesigned purchase order projection. With these tools, Inform ERP can prepare a more ‘perfect PO’, making buyers more efficient and profitable.

Advanced Demand Forecasting and Purchasing is a beta test opportunity for early adopters. The system requires configuration for vendors, products, and forecasting rules.&edsp;&edsp;DDI System strongly recommends consultation services to give you guidance on the features, configuration, setup sequence, and benefits of this new system.

After working with a DDI System consultant to get your system configured and your buyers trained, standard hotline support is available. Extensive documentation is available for self-directed learning, at http://www.ddisys.com/attachments/HTMLHelp/forecast_overview.htm.
